title: 14 · Reliability: what F8 taught
caption: Retry what passes, never what is final, and never after the answer has started; say a spent account plainly.

cards.title: A busy moment retried, a limit said plainly
cards.text: Measured first, with a free probe of the SDK, before anything was built.

cards.title: The probe
cards.text: The SDK retries before a stream; an overload inside one fails at once.

cards.title: Before any words
cards.text: The empty opening held back, so a retry says nothing twice.

cards.title: An account limit
cards.text: Our words to the chat, and an eval run stops at once.
